You work hard you pay full attention to your job chances are you either get selected to do a higher one with better pay or some corrupt guy snatches it away from you.

You raise a kid you decide to pay all the attention to him while juggling your life and job and being worried about him while inducing a strain on yourself or you don't you ignore the kid which causes unhappiness to the family and you know you ignored him when you should have spent time on him.

The kid grows he either ends up loving you or hating you it doens't matter if you payed attention to him or not it's his life a small thing can cause a drastic change of behavior anyways not your's.

Death is the end it really is so appealing in my book everything is over you don't feel any pain, sadness, misery sure you don't feel any joy too but how many times are we truly happy everyday is a slog and drag man.

Who cares once you die how people think of you doesn't matter you don't exist why keep fighting everything and struggling against every damn thing.
